name: FKN Model Viewer
author: J. Rumie Vittar by fuken

sections.description:
fuken Model Viewer is a plugin that allows you to insert and interact with 3D objects on your WordPress website. The adoption of this innovative technology in the presentation of products online is a strategic step for any business that seeks to stand out, offer differentiated value, and increase customer satisfaction. These types of objects on the web will increase user engagement and enhance your site’s revenue.

Features

  1. No flash needed
  2. Compatible with modern browsers such as Chrome, Firefox, Edge, and Safari.
  3. Augmented reality support
  4. Supports both mouse and touch.
  5. You can zoom in on the 3D object using touch.

Dependencies

This plugin uses the following third-party libraries:

  1. ThreeJS
    ThreeJS is included with the plugin to ensure compatibility and performance. No additional action is required.

  2. Draco
    The plugin integrates Draco, a library developed by Google for compressing and decompressing 3D graphics.

    • License: Apache 2.0 (compatible with GPLv2).
    • For more details, visit: Draco GitHub Repository.
      The Draco library is bundled with the plugin to improve the performance and size optimization of 3D objects.

How to use

  1. Install and activate the fuken Model Viewer plugin on your WordPress website.
  2. Upload a .glb file and click save.
  3. Copy the shortcode.
  4. Navigate to your blog post or page and use the editor to add a shortcode.
  5. Click “Publish” to see your new web page with an interactive 3D object.
  6. Congratulations, you are already enjoying your plugin.

Source Code

The uncompressed source code for the JavaScript and/or CSS files used in this plugin is available at: fkn-model-viewer. You can review, study, and adapt the code to your needs.

If you have any questions or suggestions about the source code, feel free to contact me.

fkn Model Viewer is distributed under the terms of the GNU GPL.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin, unzip it, and move the unzipped folder to the “wp-content/plugins” directory in your WordPress installation.
  2. In your admin panel, go to Plugins and you’ll find FKN Model Viewer in the plugins section.
  3. Enable the option to upload .glb files in your WordPress admin.
  4. Click on the ‘Activate’ button to use your new plugin right away.
  5. Done.
sections.faq:
Do I need technical skills to use this plugin?

No, this plugin is designed for users with no technical skills.
